params.prompt: Interactive episode player, video paused and dimmed (illustrated harbour scene). The companion 'Hi' — a round, softly glowing speech-bubble character with two friendly eyes, matching the attached reference — floats above a hint panel. Hint panel text in Turkish: 'Kafede daha kibar: "Can I have …, please?"' with a small speaker icon, and two buttons 'Bir ipucu daha' and 'Tekrar dene'. Gentle, encouraging, never punishing. No bottom navigation on this screen. High-fidelity mobile app UI mockup, single iPhone screen, portrait, flat front view, no device frame, for 'hiVelzon', an English-learning app built around an animated mystery story set in a small coastal harbour town. Design system: 8px grid, generous whitespace, 12px rounded corners, soft subtle shadows, Inter-like sans-serif with max 3 weights, palette: deep sea blue primary (#1F4E79), lighthouse yellow accent (#F2B33D), warm sand neutrals (#F7F1E6 background, #2B2B2B text), evening orange for highlights. Story artwork inside the UI is warm animated-series graphic-novel illustration with clean ink lines and soft cel shading, mature, not childish. Calm, friendly, uncluttered; no ads, no hearts/lives, no timers, no leaderboards. Bottom navigation bar with 5 tabs labelled 'Ana Sayfa', 'Keşfet', 'Hikâye', 'Konuş', 'Profil'. Legible text only, minimal text, no real brand logos.
